title: carex praeox var. refracta
intro: Carex praeox var. refracta, commonly known as refracted sedge or Carex refracta, is a type of plant that belongs to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It has been traditionally used to support digestive health and relieve symptoms associated with gastrointestinal issues, such as bloating and indigestion, due to its health benefits and therapeutic actions. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic effects of Carex praeox var. refracta.
